title: Costs tab shows the model spend ceiling and this month's spend
description:
Add a line to the Costs tab showing the organization's monthly model spend ceiling next to the month's model spend, so an owner sees how close the organization is to model_spend_ceiling_reached.

Feature: Costs tab ceiling line
  Scenario: A member sees ceiling and spend
    Given an organization with model spend this month
    When a member opens the Costs tab
    Then the ceiling and the month's spend are shown
right_now_summary: The Costs tab needs to show the monthly model spend ceiling beside this month’s spend.
